load_archive_file: download and extract a tar archive from a URL or local path into the cache directory
cached_path: resolve a URL or local file path and return the cached local file path
url_to_filename: convert a URL into a SHA256 hashed filename optionally including an etag hash
read_set_from_file: read a text file line by line and return a deduplicated set of strings
get_file_extension: extract the file extension from a path with optional dot prefix and lowercase toggle
